talk.transcript: Today, I want to discuss renewable energy sources. Renewable energy comes from natural processes that are continuously replenished, such as sunlight, wind, and water. These energy sources are sustainable and reduce our carbon footprint. Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, while wind turbines harness wind energy to generate power. Hydropower is another major source, utilizing flowing water to produce energy. As we face climate change, transitioning to renewable energy is crucial for a sustainable future.
